categories.name: indexes
categories.evidence: Modifies BaseIndex synchronization logic and LevelDB batching across src/index/ components.
categories.rationale: Batches index LevelDB writes and reduces cs_main lock acquisitions during initial index sync. The author notes this 'improves sync time on HDD due to the reduced number of disk write operations' and reduces lock contention during concurrent block validation, while serving as prerequisite work for parallel index sync in #26966.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes are confined to the optional BaseIndex synchronization loops and do not substantively modify validation logic or chainstate management.
categories.rationale: The PR reduces cs_main lock contention originating from background index threads, but changes no validation rules, consensus code, or chainstate invariants.
